envelope.description: Document view (insrc.scratchpad): render + floating Send-to-chat + generation/epoch guards

body.title: Document view (insrc.scratchpad): render + floating Send-to-chat + generation/epoch guards
body.summary: Add the insrc.scratchpad document view to the scratch-panels controller: textContent-only content render, selectionchange floating icon-only Send-to-chat button posting capped send-to-chat {text} (text captured at selectionchange), singleton with per-open generation counter (A->B switch = setTitle+setHtml on the same panel, late reads dropped), epoch bump on delete invalidating pending opens, ScratchNotFound closes the panel only if it displays that id. Plus the document-view half of scratch-panel.test.ts.
acceptanceChecks: insrc.scratchpad document view renders content via textContent only (CSP-safe)

selectionchange with non-empty selection reveals the floating icon-only Send-to-chat button (title="Send to chat") anchored at the selection; collapsed selection keeps it hidden; click posts {type:'send-to-chat', text} with the text captured at selectionchange (focus/selectionchange cannot lose it), truncated multibyte-safe so the final string incl. ellipsis stays within 65,536 UTF-8 bytes (boundary test included)

FIRST-CLASS contract — singleton A->B switch: opening B while A is displayed calls setTitle(B)+setHtml on the SAME cached panel instance, bumps the per-open generation counter, and drops a late-resolving read of A; verified by the reversed-read-completion test named in the LLD testStrategy

deleteScratch(id) bumps that id's epoch invalidating every pending open of it (in-flight read of a deleted id is dropped, not rendered); ScratchNotFound closes the panel only if it currently displays that failing id; a stale ScratchNotFound for another id is ignored; dispose invalidates the generation check

scratch-panel.test.ts document-view tests cover textContent-only render, floating button on selection, A->B setTitle on same instance with reversed read completion, stale ENOENT, deleting a non-displayed document, generation guard, dispose-during-read, selection-to-button click preserving the captured selection, UTF-8 cap boundary case

tests.name: scratch-panel.test.ts: document viewType insrc.scratchpad renders content via textContent only (ac4)

scratch-panel.test.ts: selectionchange with non-empty selection shows the floating icon-only Send-to-chat button (title) which posts send-to-chat {text}; selection-to-button click preserves the captured selection across focus/selectionchange (ac4, ac5)
scratch-panel.test.ts: A->B document switching asserts setTitle(B) on the SAME panel instance alongside content, with reversed read completion (generation guard)

scratch-panel.test.ts: stale ENOENT, deleting a non-displayed document, delete invalidates pending opens of the deleted id, closing/reopening the document panel during an outstanding read (dispose invalidates the generation, late read dropped)
scratch-panel.test.ts: UTF-8 cap — final inserted string incl. ellipsis within 65,536 bytes, with a multibyte boundary case
